name: Shoujo no Michikusa ~Houkago "Ura" Jijou~
original_name: 少女の道草 ～放課後『裏』事情～
source: A rumor is spreading around campus that there is this girl who will have sex with anyone! A school festival is coming up, let's find out if this rumor is true.
translation: 校园里流传着一个传闻：有个女孩愿意和任何人发生性关系！学园祭就要到了，让我们看看传闻是真是假。
